criteria.name: Text Type
criteria.feedback: Your essay is very well-organized, with clear introduction, body paragraphs, and conclusion; effective structure and transitions make your ideas easy to follow. To improve, consider varying your transitions for an even smoother flow.

criteria.name: Content
criteria.feedback: Your response thoroughly addresses the prompt with a clear improvement and well-supported reasons and examples, showing strong vocabulary and an understanding of both immediate and long-term consequences; adding more depth or elaboration to your explanations would help you reach a top score.

criteria.name: Accuracy
criteria.feedback: You show good control over simple sentences and use different time frames, but frequent errors with grammar, word choice, and sentence structure—especially in more complex sentences—make your writing less clear. To improve, focus on accuracy with articles, prepositions, verb tense, and word forms in complex sentences.
